name: Fudge Miracles
description: Example miracles for the Fudge Miracles rules (Fudge SRD section 7.2), written for Fudger: what a petition of each kind may grant at Good, Great and Superb. A petition at Fair or Mediocre goes unanswered. Fudge is a trademark of Grey Ghost Press.

entities.name: Healing
entities.description: A plea to mend a wounded or sick person.

Stats.Great: Heals two wound levels, or cures a sickness.

entities.name: Food and Water
entities.description: A plea for the hungry and thirsty.

Stats.Good: Enough food or clean water for a day.
Stats.Great: A feast, or a spring that runs for a week.
Stats.Superb: Food enough for a village, or a lasting well.

entities.name: Protection
entities.description: A plea to be kept safe from harm.

Stats.Great: Foes hesitate and attack at -1 for a scene.
Stats.Superb: No mundane weapon can harm the petitioner for a scene.

entities.name: Guardian
entities.description: A plea for help against enemies.

Stats.Good: A wolf, dog or similar beast comes to defend.
Stats.Great: A strong beast or a brave stranger arrives.
Stats.Superb: Three lions, or a band of warriors, answer the call.

entities.name: Guidance
entities.description: A plea to know the way or the truth.

Stats.Good: A sign that points the right way.

entities.name: Weather
entities.description: A plea to change the sky.

Stats.Good: The rain eases or the wind turns a little.
Stats.Great: A storm breaks or holds off for a day.
Stats.Superb: The weather changes as asked over a whole region.

entities.name: Light in Darkness
entities.description: A plea for light against the night or the unholy.

Stats.Good: A soft light for an hour.
Stats.Great: A bright light that unholy beings shun.
Stats.Superb: A blaze that drives back or burns the unholy.

entities.name: Smite
entities.description: A plea to strike down the deity's enemy.

Stats.Good: The enemy stumbles or drops a weapon.
Stats.Great: A blow of +2 offensive factor, as lightning or fire.

entities.name: Freedom
entities.description: A plea to be released from bonds or prison.

Stats.Good: A lock gives or a rope slips.
Stats.Great: Chains fall away and a door opens.
Stats.Superb: The prison walls crack and every captive goes free.

entities.name: Courage
entities.description: A plea for strength of heart.

Stats.Great: Allies nearby are steadied, +1 to resist fear for a scene.
Stats.Superb: The petitioner and allies are fearless, and foes falter.
